newsitem.title: UK: Geest up as co gives analysts glad tidings.
newsitem.headline: Geest up as co gives analysts glad tidings.

text.p: Shares in British foods group Geest Plc rose 9-1/2p to 295p as the company continued its upbeat meetings with analysts, they said.

"The gist is there's a continuation of strong underlying trade particularly in chilled, prepared foods except dressed salads, which for Geest means potato salad and coleslaw which are larger, more mature markets," said one analyst.
"Sales and profits growth looks close on 20 percent," he said.
He raised his forecasts for the current year by about a million stg to 23 million stg. Consensus forecasts for the year are 21.2 million.
Geest's presentations to analysts continue today.
